carried_by: the engine's checkpoint envelope: a session's counters, its channels and a state payload (FST1), as whole numbers a host stores
magic_note: the codec names the format ACK1; the stored word is 1095126833, whose four bytes spell AFO1, and it is the number that is the format
unit: words (whole numbers; a host stores each as it stores an int)
header: magic 1095126833 ("ACK1"), schema 1, the engine, content, rules and profile pins, the owner, the tick, the session's seed, the constructed state's digest, the record's cursor, the state's word count
body: one row of four words a source (epoch, last, asked, answered), three sources; then the state's words; then one word folding every word before it (FNV-1a, 32 bits a half word)
rules: a checkpoint shorter than its counts is torn
the four pins are the reader's own
the owner is the reader's fence
the last word is the fold of the rest
